facts.fact: Decree 2024-073 of 15 May 2024 states that any poor household enrolled in the Registre Social is eligible for Tekavoul regular transfers (Art. 11) and any vulnerable household enrolled in it for shock-response transfers (Art. 13), so the Registre Social is in use to choose recipients.

note: No fact for programmes or national ID link: Tekavoul and its shock component are one programme, and the decree names no ID link.
